name: Bernama TV
tagline: Explain the issue, not just the brand.
intro: Television arm of Malaysia’s national news agency, with interviews and information-led programming.

ideas.title: Commercial interview
ideas.body: Discuss an approved spokesperson-led format, clearly distinct from independent news.

ideas.title: Industry explanation
ideas.body: Develop a factual explainer with verifiable claims and relevant audience context.

name: Bernama Radio
intro: Radio arm of the national news agency with information, news and discussion formats.

ideas.title: Service information
ideas.body: Develop a practical radio message that explains a service or initiative.

ideas.title: Approved discussion
ideas.body: Discuss the commercial conversation format and editorial boundaries in advance.

name: Bernama Digital
tagline: Useful information in a multimedia world.
intro: The digital news and multimedia extension of Bernama’s wire, radio and television services.

ideas.title: Multimedia feature
ideas.body: Discuss a clearly labelled digital article or approved video production.

ideas.title: Distribution brief
ideas.body: Confirm publication, languages, formats and reporting with Bernama’s commercial team.
